author: vonderleyen
text:
Hungary has taken important steps to strengthen the rule of law and protect the Union’s financial interests.

And reforms deliver results.  

Today, we are proposing to unlock €4.2 billion and reopen the doors of Erasmus+ and Horizon Europe to Hungarian students and researchers.

I am very glad that they will once again fully benefit from the opportunities our Union creates.

http://link.europa.eu/YTp6cp
